# The following module-level variables act as a communication channel between
# the lyse GUI and analysis routines run within its analysis subprocess. When a
# routine is run stand-alone (i.e. not from within the lyse GUI) they keep the
# default values set here; when run within the GUI, the analysis worker
# overrides them (see lyse.utils.worker) to inject GUI state and to collect
# results to send back to the GUI.

# Whether this routine is running within the lyse GUI. Overridden to True by
# the analysis worker when running inside lyse.
spinning_top = False
# Results to be sent back to the lyse GUI when running within lyse.
_updated_data = {}
# Mapping of plot id's to the classes to use for the corresponding Plot object.
_plot_classes = {}
# A fake Plot object to subclass when not running in the GUI. Overridden with
# the real Plot class by the analysis worker when running inside lyse.
Plot = object
# Mapping of plot id's to Plot instances. Overridden by the analysis worker
# when running within lyse.
plots = {}
# A threading.Event used by the GUI to signal that delayed results may be
# returned (see delay_results_return).
delay_event = threading.Event()
# Whether the routine has requested that returning results be delayed until
# delay_event is set.
_delay_flag = False
